decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 3rd April 2006, the erection of a roof extension including a hip to gable alteration measuring 3.0m high, 8.8m wide with a perpendicular depth of 4.2m and a rear dormer extension that measures 3.4m deep, 5.35m wide and 2.25m high were lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - 
Informative
1.The roof lights to be located within the front roof slope of the dwellinghouse shall be flush with that roof plane.
2. The works hereby approved must be completed and available for use prior to the commencement of any works to extend the house.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the proposed erection of a hip to gable end and rear roof extension to existing house.
